+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    s.replace(ps, c) for every (ps, c) in table, in order, skipping the scans
+    that cannot match: present holds every character that may occur in s (the
+    initial ones plus every token actually created), so a pair with a character
+    outside it is not in s and its replace would be a no-op.
+    """
+    present = set(s)
+    add = present.add
+    for ps, c in table:
+        if ps[0] in present and ps[1] in present:
+            n = len(s)
+            s = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if len(s) != n:
+                add(c)
+    return s
+
